responsibility: Defines the top-level built-in derive expansion entry points for this module, wiring derive names to their expander functions, adapting statement versus item inputs, and exposing shared helper utilities and path-building macros used across derive implementations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `src/deriving/generic/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the outer derive dispatcher and glue layer: it declares the built-in derive submodules, exposes the `BuiltinDerive` expander interface, adapts statement vs. item inputs in `MultiItemModifier::expand`, and provides crate-level helper macros/utilities, instead of the generic per-field code-generation framework itself.
